title: Work experience entry
description: data/resume/experience/*.yaml — one file per role, one role per file. File names are prefixed NN_ for sort order on disk, but templates sort by `start` desc regardless.

end.description: End date, unquoted YYYY-MM-DD. Use ~ (null) for the current role — renders as "Present".

description.description: Markdown supported (bold **text**, bullet lists with '- '). Use ~ or leave empty for no description.

technologies.description: Shown as badges under the description.
